checklistText: Trash cans or recycling bins visible unnecessarily

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag freestanding trash, recycling, or compost bins visible in the frame. Do not flag bins inside closed cabinets or pull-out drawers, or decorative baskets and planters that only resemble bins.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag filled or empty garbage bags, wrappers, paper scraps, receipts, and debris on floors, counters, stairs, or furniture. Do not flag intentional decor such as a styled paper shopping bag or wrapped gifts in a staged shot.

checklistText: Cardboard boxes, shipping boxes, and moving supplies

deescalateTo.when: room is GARAGE, BASEMENT_UNFINISHED, or STORAGE and the items read as ordinary organized storage (section 6 exception), or the item is small and not distracting

visionHint: Flag cardboard or shipping boxes, packing tape, bubble wrap, and moving blankets in finished rooms. Do not flag decorative storage bins or baskets; neatly stacked boxes in garages, unfinished basements, and storage rooms are expected storage.

checklistText: Cleaning supplies, including sprays, bottles, mops, brooms, and buckets

deescalateTo.when: room is GARAGE, BASEMENT_UNFINISHED, or STORAGE and the items read as ordinary organized storage (section 6 exception), or the item is small and not distracting

visionHint: Flag spray bottles, cleaner jugs, mops, brooms, dustpans, buckets, and rags left in view. Do not flag items fully inside closed cabinets or a hand-soap dispenser at a sink.

deescalateTo.when: a small robot vacuum or dock is tucked out of the way, or the room is GARAGE, BASEMENT_UNFINISHED, or STORAGE

visionHint: Flag upright, stick, canister, and robot vacuums, their charging docks, carpet cleaners, and steam mops. Do not flag central-vacuum wall inlets or toe-kick vacuum ports (permanent features).

checklistText: Loose extension cords, charging cables, and exposed wires

escalateTo.when: cords cross the floor or a walkway, or dangle prominently in the foreground

visionHint: Flag extension cords, power strips, phone chargers, and dangling or exposed wires that are clearly visible. Do not flag a single lamp cord routed directly to an outlet, or permanent conduit and low-voltage wiring.

deescalateTo.when: faces are too small or distant to be recognizable at full resolution

visionHint: Flag framed photos, canvas prints, digital frames, and fridge photos where a person's face is recognizable at full resolution. Do not flag generic artwork, stock prints, or photos without people.

checklistText: Visible personal documents, mail, addresses, or sensitive information

deescalateTo.when: paper is visible but no names, addresses, account numbers, or other sensitive text is legible at full resolution

visionHint: Flag mail, envelopes, bills, prescription labels, calendars, whiteboards, and notes where names, addresses, account numbers, or schedules are legible. Do not flag the subject property's own house number or blank stationery.

deescalateTo.when: footwear is neatly stored on a rack or shelf (for example inside a closet shot), or is small and in the background

visionHint: Flag shoes, boots, slippers, and sandals on floors, stairs, entry mats, porches, or furniture. Do not flag shoes neatly displayed on built-in closet shelving in an intentional closet shot.

checklistText: Coats, purses, backpacks, and personal accessories

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag coats draped on chairs or railings, purses, backpacks, keys, wallets, sunglasses, hats, and lanyards. Do not flag staged decor items or a single coat neatly hung inside an intentional closet shot.

checklistText: Pet bowls, toys, leashes, crates, and litter boxes

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag pet food and water bowls, feeders, toys, leashes, crates, gates, pet beds, and litter boxes. Do not flag built-in pet features such as a pet door or built-in dog-wash station (permanent).

checklistText: Children's toys and play equipment creating clutter

deescalateTo.when: a few toys are neatly stored in bins or on shelves in a playroom, or are small and not distracting

visionHint: Flag toys, play mats, ride-ons, baby gear (bouncers, high chairs, play yards), and scattered kids' items on floors or furniture. Do not flag a tidy playroom where toys are organized in bins or built-in storage.

checklistText: Laundry baskets, dirty clothing, and loose clothing

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag laundry baskets, hampers, piles of clothing, and garments draped over furniture, doors, or railings. Do not flag clothing neatly hung inside an intentionally shown closet.

deescalateTo.when: only a few small items, or small non-distracting clutter

visionHint: Flag counters, tables, dressers, and shelves crowded with everyday items such as papers, keys, bottles, chargers, and random objects. Do not flag one to three intentionally styled decor pieces (vase, bowl, plant, stacked books).

checklistText: Open cabinets, drawers, or closets that should be closed

deescalateTo.when: a closet or pantry is intentionally open to showcase tidy storage

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open cabinet doors, drawers, and closet doors so they sit flush and fully closed, matching the existing door style and hardware. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag cabinet doors, drawers, or closet doors left ajar or open without purpose. Do not flag a walk-in closet or pantry intentionally opened to showcase storage (door fully open, interior tidy).

checklistText: Awkwardly positioned or partially open doors

escalateTo.when: the door cuts across the frame, blocks part of the room, or hides a key feature

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the partially open door so it sits fully closed in its frame, matching the existing door style and hardware. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag interior or exterior doors left at an awkward partial angle that cut into the frame or look accidental. Do not flag doors fully open against a wall or fully closed.

checklistText: Crooked rugs, furniture, and decorative objects

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Straighten the crooked rug or decor item so it sits square to the room and the furniture, keeping its pattern, size, and position otherwise identical. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag area rugs, furniture, or decor visibly askew relative to the walls or to each other (rug edges at an angle to the sofa, frames hanging crooked). Do not flag intentionally angled accent chairs or organic layouts that look deliberate.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Smooth the wrinkles in the textile so it lies neat and flat, keeping its color, pattern, and position identical. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag rumpled tablecloths, runners, throws, slipcovers, and curtains with heavy creases or bunching. Do not flag textured fabrics (linen, chunky knit) whose texture is by design.

escalateTo.when: the crooked shade or fixture is in the foreground or a hero photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Straighten the tilted lampshade so it sits level and centered on the lamp, keeping the same shade. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag lampshades visibly tilted or with the seam facing the camera, and pendant shades hanging askew. Do not flag fixtures that only appear angled from wide-angle distortion near the frame edges.

escalateTo.when: curtains are bunched, drawn on only one side, or block a window view in a hero photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Even out the curtain panels so both sides hang symmetrically with matching gathers, keeping the same fabric and rod. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag curtain panels at mismatched widths, one side pulled back and the other not, panels tangled on rods, or hems bunched on the floor. Do not flag intentionally asymmetrical single-panel styling.

checklistText: Inconsistent blind positions within a room

escalateTo.when: blinds on the same wall are at clearly different heights or slat angles in a hero photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Make the window blinds in this room consistent: same height and same slat angle on every window. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag blinds or shades within one room at different heights, some open and some closed, or with mismatched slat angles. Do not flag different treatment types on windows that clearly differ in size or purpose.

Flag movable objects (plants, boxes, equipment, stacked items) placed in front of fireplaces, built-ins, windows, staircases, or other architectural features so the feature is partly hidden. Do not flag furniture in its normal functional position.

deescalateTo.when: room is GARAGE, BASEMENT_UNFINISHED, or STORAGE and the items read as ordinary organized storage (section 6 exception), or the item is small and not distracting

visionHint: Flag paint cans, rollers, trays, drop cloths, drywall sheets, lumber, buckets of joint compound, and contractor tools. Do not flag finished trim or permanent fixtures; neatly shelved paint cans in a garage are ordinary storage.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag manufacturer stickers on new appliances, fixtures, or windows, price tags, open-house or wet-paint signs, sticky notes, and contractor labels. Do not flag house numbers or builder plaques; treat realtor yard signs as candidates for review rather than automatic removal.

checklistText: Green, blue, or yellow painter's tape on windows, doors, frames, cabinets, or handles
visionHint: Flag strips of green, blue, or yellow painter's tape on windows, doors, frames, trim, cabinets, or handles (common after paint touch-ups or staging). Confirm it reads as tape (matte strip, lifted edge, crossing a seam); do not flag painted trim or colored decor.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Catch-all for personal items not covered by a more specific rule (toiletry bags, indoor sports gear, medical equipment, hobby supplies, firearms) that draw attention. Do not flag normal furnishings or styled decor.

checklistText: Visible people or pets unless intentionally included and approved

escalateTo.when: a person's face is recognizable and the order does not mark the photo as an approved lifestyle shot (privacy)

visionHint: Flag any person or animal in the frame, including partial bodies at frame edges and people visible through windows. Skip photos the order or client instructions mark as intentional lifestyle shots; photographer reflections are handled by the REFL rules.
Flag dishes, pots, utensils, or food residue in the sink or on its edge. Do not flag an empty clean sink or a single styled item beside it.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag used plates, bowls, mugs, utensils, drying racks, and stacked dishes on counters or islands. Do not flag an intentionally staged place setting or a decorative fruit bowl.

checklistText: Dish soap, sponges, scrubbers, or cleaning brushes

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag dish soap bottles, sponges, scrubbers, brushes, and sponge caddies at the sink. Do not flag a built-in soap dispenser mounted in the countertop.

escalateTo.when: the towel is crumpled, stained, or a focal point of a hero kitchen shot

reeditPromptTemplate: Straighten the dish towel so it hangs evenly and neatly folded on the handle, keeping its color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag dish towels bunched, crumpled, hanging crooked, or draped over the faucet or sink edge. Do not flag a single neatly folded towel hung straight on an oven handle.

checklistText: Paper towel rolls left in distracting locations

escalateTo.when: the roll sits in the foreground or center of a hero kitchen shot

visionHint: Flag paper towel rolls and stand holders on counters, islands, or sills where they draw attention. Do not flag an under-cabinet mounted holder that is barely visible.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag freestanding kitchen trash, recycling, or compost bins, including stainless step cans beside the island. Do not flag bins hidden in a closed pull-out cabinet.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag food storage containers, takeout boxes, packaging, bread bags, and opened food items on counters or tables. Do not flag a styled fruit bowl, fresh flowers, or a matching canister set.

checklistText: Cereal boxes, snack bags, and groceries

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag cereal boxes, chip or snack bags, grocery bags, and pantry goods on counters, refrigerator tops, or open shelving. Do not flag neatly arranged items behind closed glass-front cabinet doors.

checklistText: Cups, bottles, and other unnecessary drink containers

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag mugs, cups, water bottles, soda cans, coffee cups, and wine bottles left on counters, tables, or islands. Do not flag an intentionally staged wine bottle with glasses or a styled carafe.

checklistText: Refrigerator magnets, notes, calendars, or paperwork

escalateTo.when: names, addresses, account numbers, prescription labels, or recognizable faces are legible at full resolution (privacy-sensitive information)

visionHint: Flag magnets, photos, notes, calendars, kids' artwork, and papers on refrigerator doors or sides. Note in the finding if names, schedules, addresses, or faces are legible.

checklistText: Items stored on top of the refrigerator

escalateTo.when: items are piled up or clearly visible in a hero kitchen shot

visionHint: Flag boxes, bags, bottles, baskets, or stored items sitting on top of the refrigerator. Do not flag cabinetry above the refrigerator or a single decorative piece.

escalateTo.when: three or more small appliances crowd the counters

visionHint: Flag countertop toasters, air fryers, blenders, coffee makers, stand mixers, and similar small appliances beyond one neatly placed item. Do not flag built-in or installed appliances (over-range microwave, built-in coffee system, wine fridge).

deescalateTo.when: only a few small items, or small non-distracting clutter

visionHint: Flag counters and islands where everyday items cover a noticeable share of the surface or many objects compete for attention. Do not flag one to three intentional styling pieces (cutting board, bowl, plant, cookbook).

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open kitchen cabinet doors and drawers so they sit flush, matching the surrounding cabinet fronts and hardware. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag any kitchen cabinet door or drawer that is ajar or open. Do not flag open shelving, closed glass-front cabinets, or an appliance garage designed to stay open.

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open appliance door so it is fully shut and matches the appliance's existing finish and handle. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag refrigerator, freezer, dishwasher, oven, microwave, or wine-fridge doors that are open or ajar. Do not flag closed glass-front appliances.

checklistText: Cookware left on the stove unnecessarily

escalateTo.when: multiple pots or pans, or used or dirty cookware

visionHint: Flag pots, pans, kettles, utensils, and spoon rests on the cooktop. Do not flag a single clean kettle or Dutch oven that is clearly styled.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

reeditPromptTemplate: Clean the stovetop surface: remove grease, crumbs, spills, and stains while keeping the burners, grates, knobs, and controls exactly as they are. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag grease, food spills, crumbs, burnt residue, or clutter (oil bottles, salt shakers) on the cooktop. Do not flag normal reflections or the burner grate pattern.

reeditPromptTemplate: Turn off the faucet: remove the running water stream and any splashing, leaving the faucet and sink unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag a visible stream of water from a faucet, pot filler, or shower head. Do not flag water features or fountains meant to run, or reflections that look like streaks.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Arrange the barstools evenly: equal spacing, same distance from the island, all facing straight ahead, keeping the same stools. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag barstools pulled out at different distances, rotated at random angles, or bunched together. Do not flag stools evenly tucked under the counter.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Push the dining chairs in evenly so they are equally spaced and square to the table, keeping the same chairs. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag dining chairs pulled out unevenly, angled, or spaced irregularly around the table. Do not flag a single chair angled out deliberately for styling when the rest are aligned.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Straighten the placemats and table runner so they are centered and square to the table edge, keeping their color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag placemats or runners that are off-center, skewed, or unevenly spaced. Do not flag round tables where rotation is ambiguous.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the uneven place settings and leave the tabletop clean, keeping the centerpiece and the table itself unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag mismatched, partial, or cluttered place settings (some seats set, others not; stacked plates; napkins askew). Do not flag a complete, symmetrical staged setting.

escalateTo.when: the difference changes the perceived color family (navy to black, white to cream, gray to blue) and materially misrepresents the property

visionHint: Flag cabinets of the same finish that show visibly different hue or brightness within one photo (a warm patch on one run, a blue cast near windows, uneven masking). Do not flag intentional two-tone kitchens where the island or uppers are a different finish by design.
cvHint: For cabinet bounding boxes returned by vision, compute mean Lab per region; flag when deltaE2000 between same-finish regions exceeds 6 (starting value, calibrate).

checklistText: Cabinet colors that appear significantly different from the RAW photographs

escalateTo.when: the difference changes the perceived color family (navy to black, white to cream, gray to blue) and materially misrepresents the property

visionHint: Compare cabinet color in the edit against the matching original or RAW-derived frame. Flag a visible shift in hue or relative tone; the original is often darker overall, so judge hue and tone relative to neighboring surfaces, not absolute brightness.
cvHint: Resize edit and original to 1024 px; in the cabinet bbox compute mean Lab after scaling L* by the global exposure ratio; flag when deltaE2000 exceeds 8 (starting value, calibrate).

checklistText: Kitchen islands appearing black when their actual color is navy blue or another dark color

escalateTo.when: the RAW comparison or the photographer confirms the real color is not black (materially inaccurate property color)

visionHint: Flag islands or dark cabinetry that read as neutral black in the edit while the original shows a blue, green, or other chromatic dark tone. If no original is available, report it as uncertain for photographer verification; never decide the true color from appearance alone.
cvHint: In the island bbox compare chroma C* (Lab) between edit and original; flag when original C* exceeds 6 and edited C* is below 3 (starting values, calibrate).

checklistText: Different cabinet colors between photographs of the same kitchen

escalateTo.when: the difference changes the perceived color family (navy to black, white to cream, gray to blue) and materially misrepresents the property

visionHint: Look at all kitchen photos together and flag any where the same cabinets read as a different color (warmer, cooler, lighter, darker) than in the other angles. Name the outlier photos, not the majority.
cvHint: Per kitchen photo, mean Lab of cabinet bboxes; flag photos whose deltaE2000 to the kitchen median exceeds 5 (starting value, calibrate).

checklistText: Incorrect masking that changes countertop, floor, cabinet, or wall colors

escalateTo.when: a significant masking failure materially changes a surface color

visionHint: Compare to the original and flag regions where a surface color shifted along a mask edge (a counter tinted by a window mask, a floor picking up blue from a window pull, a wall taking on cabinet color). Do not flag uniform global white-balance changes; color rules handle those.

checklistText: Unrealistic cabinet or countertop textures caused by editing
visionHint: Flag cabinet or countertop surfaces that look painted over, smeared, plastic, overly smooth, or show warped or repeating stone or wood patterns. Do not flag genuine high-gloss finishes that show normal reflections.

checklistText: Toilet lids or seats left open
reeditPromptTemplate: Close the toilet seat and lid so the lid lies flat and closed, matching the existing toilet. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag any toilet with the lid or seat raised, or with the bowl interior visible. Do not flag a toilet whose lid is closed, or lidless designs.

checklistText: Toilet paper hanging loosely or prominently displayed

escalateTo.when: long loose tails, stacked spare rolls, or a roll that is a focal point

reeditPromptTemplate: Neaten the toilet paper so the roll sits tidy on its holder with no loose tail. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag toilet paper with long loose tails, crumpled rolls, spare-roll stacks on tanks or floors, or rolls placed front and center. Do not flag a neat roll on its holder that is small in the frame.
Flag toilet brushes (with or without holders) and plungers anywhere in frame, including partly hidden beside the toilet. Do not flag supply valves or bidet fixtures.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag wastebaskets and small bathroom bins. Do not flag decorative baskets holding rolled towels.

checklistText: Shampoo, conditioner, and body wash bottles

deescalateTo.when: one or two small bottles are neatly placed and barely visible

visionHint: Flag shampoo, conditioner, and body-wash bottles on tub ledges, shower floors, niches, or counters. Do not flag built-in wall-mounted dispensers.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag toothbrushes, holders, toothpaste tubes, mouthwash bottles, floss, and water flossers on vanities or sinks. Do not flag an empty built-in toothbrush holder.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag razors, shaving cream cans, electric shavers, and trimmers on counters, ledges, or in showers.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag makeup, brushes, palettes, lotions, deodorant, perfume clusters, hairbrushes, and hair products on vanities or shelves. Do not flag a single styled perfume tray or decorative jar.

checklistText: Prescription medication or personal hygiene products

escalateTo.when: names, addresses, account numbers, prescription labels, or recognizable faces are legible at full resolution (privacy-sensitive information)

visionHint: Flag prescription bottles, pill organizers, medical supplies, feminine hygiene products, and similar personal items. Note in the finding if a pharmacy label, a name, or a medication name is legible.

checklistText: Hair dryers, straighteners, and curling irons

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag hair dryers, straighteners, curling irons, and their dangling cords on counters or hooks. Do not flag a permanently wall-mounted hotel-style hair dryer.

reeditPromptTemplate: Replace the used towel with the same towel neatly folded and hung straight on its bar, keeping its color. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag towels that look used: crumpled, damp, stained, piled on floors or tub edges, or draped over shower doors. Do not flag clean towels that are neatly folded or hung.

escalateTo.when: the towel is a focal point of a hero bathroom photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Straighten the hanging towel so it hangs evenly and neatly folded on its bar, keeping its color and position. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag towels hanging lopsided, bunched, half off the bar, or with mismatched fold lengths. Do not flag a single neatly placed decorative towel.

escalateTo.when: the mat is bunched or stained, or several mats crowd the floor

visionHint: Flag bath mats and contour rugs that are crumpled, askew, stained, or wrapped around the toilet base. Do not flag a single flat, clean mat aligned with the tub or vanity.

escalateTo.when: the curtain is bunched, half-closed hiding the tub, or hanging off its rings

reeditPromptTemplate: Neatly arrange the shower curtain pulled to one side, hanging straight with even folds, keeping its color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag shower curtains that are bunched, twisted, half-drawn, or hanging off rings. Do not flag a curtain neatly drawn to one side or fully open to show the tub.

deescalateTo.when: faint and only visible when zoomed in

reeditPromptTemplate: Clean the shower glass: remove water spots, streaks, and soap film while keeping the glass transparent and the frame and hardware unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag visible water spots, soap scum, streaks, or fogging on shower glass. Do not flag frosted, textured, or patterned glass, or normal reflections.

deescalateTo.when: faint and only visible when zoomed in

reeditPromptTemplate: Clean the mirror surface: remove water spots, splatter, and streaks while keeping the reflection and the mirror frame unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag water spots, toothpaste splatter, streaks, or smudges on mirrors. Do not flag desilvering at mirror edges (a property condition for human review, not a cleaning edit).

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

reeditPromptTemplate: Clean the sink basin and countertop: remove water spots, residue, hair, and stains while keeping the counter material, pattern, and fixtures identical. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag toothpaste residue, hair, soap scum, water spots, or grime in sinks or on vanity tops. Do not flag natural stone veining or patterned countertops.

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open vanity or medicine-cabinet doors and drawers so they sit flush and closed, matching the existing cabinetry and hardware. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag vanity doors, drawers, linen cabinets, or medicine cabinets left open or ajar. Do not flag open shelving or towel cubbies designed to be open.

escalateTo.when: the door blocks the view into the shower or creates heavy doubled reflections

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the glass shower door fully so it sits flush in its frame, keeping the glass, frame, and hardware unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag glass shower or tub doors left half-open at an angle that cuts through the composition, doubles reflections, or blocks the shower interior. Do not flag doors fully closed or fully open against a wall.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag spray bottles, scrub brushes, toilet cleaner, sponges, buckets, and squeegees. Do not flag permanently mounted accessories such as towel bars or paper holders.

deescalateTo.when: a small, neatly arranged matching set

visionHint: Flag bottles, razors, sponges, loofahs, and kids' bath toys on shower niches, caddies, corner shelves, or tub ledges. Do not flag an empty built-in niche.

checklistText: Toilet bowls unnecessarily emphasized in compositions
visionHint: Flag compositions where the toilet is the dominant or centered subject, sits in the near foreground, or is the first thing the eye lands on. Do not flag a toilet visible as a normal part of a wide bathroom view.

checklistText: Excessive fisheye distortion in small bathrooms
visionHint: Flag small bathrooms where walls bow outward, the vanity or tub stretches at the frame edges, or the room looks unnaturally deep from an ultra-wide lens. Do not flag mild edge stretch that keeps straight lines straight.

checklistText: Bathroom images that fail to clearly represent the space

escalateTo.when: no photo of this bathroom shows how the vanity, shower or tub, and toilet relate

visionHint: For each distinct bathroom, check whether at least one photo conveys its layout. Flag bathrooms shown only as a corner, a mirror, or a fixture close-up; do not flag detail shots when a wide shot of the same bathroom exists.

deescalateTo.when: subtle and not distracting

visionHint: Flag bathrooms with harsh vanity-light hotspots, strong yellow and blue mixed lighting, a dark shower interior, or an obvious flash-lit look. Do not flag the natural warm glow of vanity lights when the rest of the room is neutral.

checklistText: Unwanted reflections in mirrors or shower glass
visionHint: Flag reflections in bathroom mirrors or shower glass showing an open door, the toilet, clutter in another room, or a bright light source. Photographer and camera reflections are handled by REFL_PHOTOGRAPHER_IN_MIRROR; do not flag natural reflections of the room's own finishes.

reeditPromptTemplate: Make the bed neatly: comforter pulled flat and square, pillows upright against the headboard, keeping the same bedding colors and patterns. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag beds with pulled-back or tangled covers, exposed sheets, or a bare mattress. Do not flag a made bed with a throw intentionally folded at the foot.

escalateTo.when: heavy wrinkles across the whole bed in a primary bedroom photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Smooth the comforter so it lies flat and crisp across the bed, keeping the same color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag comforters, duvets, or bedspreads with heavy creases, lumps, or sagging corners. Do not flag textured or quilted bedding whose pattern is by design.

escalateTo.when: pillows are toppled, piled, or missing from one side

reeditPromptTemplate: Arrange the bed pillows evenly and symmetrically against the headboard, keeping the same pillows. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag sleeping pillows at different heights, leaning, flattened, or asymmetrical across the bed. Do not flag an intentional asymmetrical layered arrangement that looks styled.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Arrange the decorative pillows neatly and symmetrically, plumped and upright, keeping the same pillows. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag throw pillows that are toppled, crushed, piled randomly, or unevenly spaced. Do not flag a deliberate odd-number or layered arrangement that looks styled.

escalateTo.when: blankets are piled up or trailing onto the floor

reeditPromptTemplate: Fold the loose blanket neatly across the foot of the bed, keeping its color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag blankets and throws tossed across beds, chairs, or floors. Do not flag a neatly folded throw at the foot of the bed or draped intentionally over a chair arm.

checklistText: Charging cables and electronics left visible

escalateTo.when: laptops, tablets, or tangled cables sit prominently on the bed or nightstand

visionHint: Flag phone chargers, dangling cables, laptops, tablets, game consoles, and headphones on beds, nightstands, or floors. Do not flag a lamp cord or a built-in USB outlet.

escalateTo.when: personal items (medications, glasses, tissues) or a heavily cluttered surface in a primary bedroom photo

visionHint: Flag nightstands holding more than about three items or any personal items (glasses, medications, tissues, chargers, water glasses, book piles). Do not flag a lamp plus one or two decor pieces.

deescalateTo.when: faces are not recognizable and nothing sensitive is legible

visionHint: Flag family photos with recognizable faces, children's names on wall decor, medications, firearms, open safes, and documents. Do not flag generic art prints or framed landscapes.

checklistText: Clothes left on beds, floors, or furniture

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag garments on beds, floors, chairs, and benches, and clothing hanging on doors. Do not flag clothing neatly hung inside an intentionally shown closet.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag shoes, slippers, and boots on bedroom floors or furniture. Do not flag shoes neatly shelved inside a closet shot.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag hampers, laundry baskets, and piles of worn clothing. Do not flag a closed decorative wicker chest with no visible laundry.

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open closet door so it sits fully closed in its frame, matching the existing door style and hardware. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag closet doors left open where the interior shows piled clothes, bins, or clutter. Do not flag an intentionally open walk-in closet with tidy, organized contents.

deescalateTo.when: toys are neatly stored in bins or on shelves in a child's room

visionHint: Flag toys, stuffed animals, and play items scattered on floors, beds, or furniture. Do not flag a tidy child's room where a few toys are styled on shelves or in bins.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag pet beds, crates, bowls, toys, and grooming items in bedrooms. Do not flag a built-in pet nook (permanent).

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Straighten the bedside lampshade so it sits level and centered on the lamp, keeping the same lamp and shade. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag bedside lamps with tilted shades, mismatched heights on a symmetric pair, or seams facing the camera. Do not flag lamps distorted only by the lens near frame edges.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Make the curtains and blinds even: panels hanging symmetrically and blinds at matching heights and slat angles. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag bedroom curtains or blinds at mismatched heights, half-drawn on one side, or tangled. Do not flag blackout shades fully raised and out of view.

Flag furniture placed so it hides a window, fireplace, built-in, closet, or ensuite doorway from the camera's viewpoint. Do not flag furniture in its normal functional position when the feature is still readable.

checklistText: Excessive cropping that makes rooms appear smaller
visionHint: Flag bedroom photos cropped so tightly that the bed fills the frame, corners are lost, or the room reads smaller than the original capture. Do not flag intentional vignette shots when a wide view of the same room exists.

checklistText: Door positions obstructing the room or furniture

escalateTo.when: the door hides a significant part of the room or furniture

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the obstructing door so it sits fully closed in its frame, matching the existing door style. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag doors (entry, closet, bathroom) swung into the frame so they block furniture or part of the room. Do not flag doors fully open against a wall.

checklistText: Distorted bed frames, walls, or furniture caused by wide-angle lenses
visionHint: Flag beds, headboards, dressers, or walls that look stretched, wedge-shaped, or bowed from an ultra-wide lens, especially near the frame edges. Do not flag normal perspective convergence toward the back wall.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
checklistText: Visible TV cables or loose electronics wiring

escalateTo.when: cables hang below a wall-mounted TV or cross the floor in a hero photo

visionHint: Flag cords hanging below wall-mounted TVs, tangled wiring behind media consoles, power strips, and loose gaming or speaker cables. Do not flag in-wall cable covers or neatly concealed cord channels.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: several remotes or controllers are scattered across a coffee table in a hero photo

visionHint: Flag TV remotes, game controllers, and streaming remotes on coffee tables, sofas, or consoles. Do not flag wall-mounted keypads or thermostats.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
checklistText: Distracting TV screen glare or reflections

deescalateTo.when: faint reflection that does not draw the eye

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the glare and reflections on the TV screen so it appears as an evenly dark, matte-black screen that is off. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag TV screens showing bright window reflections, lamp hotspots, or the room mirrored back. Do not flag a uniformly dark screen with a faint natural sheen.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
reeditPromptTemplate: Turn the TV off: make the screen an even, dark, matte black with no image, logo, or menu. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag TVs showing a program, menu, screensaver, logo, error message, or any image. Do not flag a screen that is off; a single artwork in art mode is acceptable unless it looks like a menu or advertisement.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Arrange the sofa and chair throw pillows neatly and symmetrically, plumped and upright, keeping the same pillows. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag throw pillows toppled, crushed, piled in one corner, or unevenly spaced on sofas and chairs. Do not flag a deliberate layered or asymmetric arrangement that looks styled.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
checklistText: Blankets left unfolded or poorly positioned

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Fold the loose throw blanket neatly and drape it over the arm of the sofa, keeping its color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag blankets bunched on sofas, tossed on floors, or hanging off cushions. Do not flag a neatly folded throw draped intentionally over an arm or basket.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: only a few small items, or small non-distracting clutter

visionHint: Flag coffee and side tables covered with remotes, cups, papers, toys, and miscellaneous items. Do not flag a styled tray, a vase, or a short stack of books.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
checklistText: Newspapers, mail, paperwork, or magazines left scattered

escalateTo.when: names, addresses, account numbers, prescription labels, or recognizable faces are legible at full resolution (privacy-sensitive information)

visionHint: Flag newspapers, mail, paperwork, and magazines scattered on tables, sofas, or floors. Note in the finding if names, addresses, or account details are legible. Do not flag a single neat styled magazine stack.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: shelves are crammed or visibly messy in a hero photo

visionHint: Flag bookshelves or built-ins crammed with mixed items, toppled books, piles of papers, or toys. Do not flag neatly styled shelves with books and decor, even when full.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag toys, play mats, baby gear, and kids' items on floors, sofas, and tables in living spaces. Do not flag a tidy toy basket that blends with the decor.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag pet toys, beds, bowls, crates, gates, leashes, and scratching posts in living spaces. Do not flag a built-in pet door.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag spray bottles, dusters, vacuums, mops, and cleaning caddies in living spaces. Do not flag fireplace tool sets.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Even out the sofa and chair cushions so they sit flat, aligned, and evenly plumped, keeping the same upholstery. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag sofa cushions that are slumped, gapped, or misaligned, and chairs or tables visibly askew relative to the room. Do not flag intentionally angled accent chairs.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag firewood piles, log carriers, ash buckets, toys, or stored items on the hearth or mantel that look cluttered. Do not flag a neat fireplace tool set, a styled log stack, or a few mantel decor pieces.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: paper clutter is visible but no names, addresses, account numbers, or other sensitive text is legible

visionHint: Flag paperwork, bills, tax documents, contracts, sticky notes, whiteboards, and calendars in offices, especially where text is legible. Do not flag closed binders or blank notepads.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: the screen shows only a generic wallpaper or logo with nothing personal

reeditPromptTemplate: Turn the computer monitor off: make the screen an even dark black with no content. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag lit computer monitors, laptops, tablets, or phones showing email, documents, accounts, photos, or any readable content. Do not flag screens that are off or dark.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: a tangle of cables is prominent in the office hero photo

visionHint: Flag tangled power, monitor, and charging cables around desks and under desk surfaces. Do not flag cables neatly routed through a grommet or tray.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Push the desk chair in so it is centered and square to the desk, keeping the same chair. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag desk chairs spun sideways, pushed far from the desk, or blocking the view of the desk. Do not flag a chair slightly pulled out but square to the desk.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag wastebaskets and shredder bins in offices. Do not flag a decorative basket holding blankets.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
visionHint: Flag furniture pushed awkwardly against walls, blocking walkways, turned away from the camera, or clustered so the room reads cramped (poor furniture presentation). Do not flag functional layouts that simply differ from typical staging.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: the reflection shows clutter, a bright window hotspot, or a confusing duplicate of the room in a hero photo

visionHint: Flag wall mirrors or glossy surfaces reflecting clutter, bright windows, or a confusing duplicate of the room. Photographer and camera reflections are handled by REFL_PHOTOGRAPHER_IN_MIRROR; do not flag natural reflections of the room.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
checklistText: Missing or poorly rendered fireplace flame effects when enhancement was requested

escalateTo.when: the order explicitly includes a fireplace enhancement and every fireplace photo is missing it (missing requested feature)

reeditPromptTemplate: Add a natural, realistic fire in the existing fireplace firebox with a soft warm glow on the hearth. Do not change the fireplace surround or mantel. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Only applies when the order or client instructions request fireplace fire. Flag fireplaces with no flame, or a flame that looks pasted on, floating, wrongly scaled, or casts no glow on nearby surfaces.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office
reeditPromptTemplate: Make the fireplace fire look natural: realistic flame size and color sitting on the logs or burner with a soft glow, without changing the fireplace structure. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag fire effects that are oversized, cartoonish, floating above the grate, clipping through the firebox edge, or that alter the fireplace surround. Do not flag a real fire that is simply bright.

sectionName: Living Room, Family Room, and Office

escalateTo.when: the difference changes the perceived color family (navy to black, white to cream, gray to blue) and materially misrepresents the property

visionHint: Compare photos of the same living, family, dining, or office space and flag angles where the same walls read as a different color. Name the outlier photos, and use white trim and ceilings as the neutral reference.
cvHint: Per photo, mean Lab of wall bboxes (from vision) on mid-tones; flag photos whose deltaE2000 to the same-room median exceeds 5 (starting value, calibrate).

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag piles of dirty clothes, overflowing baskets, and laundry on machines, floors, or folding counters. Do not flag a single empty basket neatly placed on a shelf.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: many containers crowd the machines or the counter

visionHint: Flag detergent jugs, pod tubs, softener bottles, and dryer-sheet boxes on top of machines or counters. Do not flag products neatly stored on a closed shelf or inside cabinets.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage
reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open washer or dryer door so it sits shut and matches the machine's existing finish. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag front-load doors or top-load lids left open on washers and dryers. Do not flag closed machines.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage
checklistText: Cleaning products scattered throughout the room

deescalateTo.when: room is GARAGE, BASEMENT_UNFINISHED, or STORAGE and the items read as ordinary organized storage (section 6 exception), or the item is small and not distracting

visionHint: Flag cleaning sprays, jugs, buckets, mops, and brooms scattered on floors, machines, or counters. Do not flag products neatly organized on shelving in a garage or storage room.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: tools are scattered on floors, stairs, or walkways rather than stored

visionHint: Flag hand and power tools left on floors, stairs, steps, or across work areas. Do not flag tools hung on pegboards or stored in a tool chest (section 6 exception).

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: the workbench is the focal point and heavily cluttered

visionHint: Flag workbenches buried in loose tools, parts, cans, and debris. Do not flag an organized bench with tools on a pegboard (section 6 exception).

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: most of the floor is covered or the room's size cannot be judged

visionHint: Flag floors covered with loose items, bags, boxes, or debris so the floor area cannot be seen. Do not flag organized storage along the walls of a garage, unfinished basement, or storage room (section 6 exception).

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: boxes hide the water heater, electrical panel, sump, laundry hookups, or a doorway

visionHint: Flag stacked boxes or bins in front of mechanicals, laundry hookups, windows, or doorways so the feature cannot be seen. Do not flag storage stacked along a blank wall.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: the cord crosses the main walkway in the foreground

visionHint: Flag extension cords running across floors, stairs, or doorways. Do not flag cords plugged in along the wall to a fixed appliance.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: the appliance (washer, dryer, water heater, furnace, freezer) cannot be identified

visionHint: Flag bags, bins, clothes, or equipment piled on or in front of appliances so the appliance is partly hidden. Do not flag items on a shelf above the appliance.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: storage is chaotic enough that the room's size or condition cannot be judged

visionHint: Flag storage areas where items are heaped randomly rather than shelved or stacked. Ordinary organized storage in garages, unfinished basements, and storage rooms is expected and should not be flagged (section 6 exception).

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage

escalateTo.when: the bins are in the foreground, centered, or overflowing

visionHint: Flag trash and recycling bins that sit in the foreground or center of a garage photo. Do not flag bins parked along a side wall in the background (ordinary garage storage).

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage
checklistText: Unnecessary vehicles or equipment obstructing the room
visionHint: Flag cars, motorcycles, mowers, trailers, or large equipment that fill the garage or storage space and hide its size or features. Do not flag a neatly parked mower along a side wall.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage
checklistText: Poor compositions that fail to show the laundry area clearly

escalateTo.when: no photo in the gallery shows the washer and dryer area clearly

visionHint: Flag laundry photos that show only a corner, a door, or a close-up where the machines, counter, and storage are not clearly visible. Do not flag a compact laundry closet shot straight-on with the doors open.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage
checklistText: Missing important utility or room features

escalateTo.when: the client instructions or listing highlight the feature (new HVAC, generator, EV charger, workshop) and no photo shows it

visionHint: Across utility-room photos, note whether listing-relevant features (water heater, HVAC, electrical panel, sump, EV charger, built-in storage, workshop) are shown. Report as uncertain coverage, never as a definitive miss; P4 confirms coverage against order data.

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage
checklistText: Excessive shadows or underexposure in unfinished spaces

escalateTo.when: large areas are near-black with no recoverable detail

visionHint: Confirm the photo reads dark with deep shadow pockets in corners, ceilings, or under stairs where detail is lost. Do not flag dark materials such as black-painted open joists.
cvHint: Luma histogram on a 1024 px image: flag when more than 25% of pixels have luma below 15 (0 to 255) or median luma is below 60 (starting values, calibrate).

sectionName: Laundry Room, Garage, Basement, and Storage
checklistText: Incorrect wall colors after HDR processing

escalateTo.when: the difference changes the perceived color family (navy to black, white to cream, gray to blue) and materially misrepresents the property

visionHint: Compare walls in the edit against the original and flag when HDR processing shifted wall color (gray drywall turned blue or beige, concrete tinted). Judge hue relative to neutral references, not brightness.
cvHint: In wall bboxes compare mean a*, b* (Lab) between edit and original; flag when the Euclidean difference exceeds 6 (starting value, calibrate).

checklistText: Trash cans or recycling bins in primary exterior compositions

deescalateTo.when: a secondary exterior view (side yard, utility area) where the bins are small and not distracting

visionHint: Flag trash, recycling, or yard-waste bins in front, rear, twilight, or aerial compositions, including at the curb or beside the garage. Do not flag enclosed bin corrals or permanent sheds.

escalateTo.when: the vehicle hides a significant part of the front facade in the primary exterior photo

visionHint: Flag cars, trucks, trailers, boats, or RVs parked in front of the facade, garage, or entry so part of the home is hidden. Do not flag vehicles on the street that do not overlap the home.

Flag a vehicle parked at the curb or on the street in front of the property that is likely the photographer's (often the same car appearing in exterior and aerial shots). Do not flag cars parked in front of neighboring homes.

escalateTo.when: the vehicle is large, brightly colored, or centered in a window view in a hero photo

visionHint: In interior photos, flag cars, trucks, or trailers clearly visible through windows or glass doors. Do not flag distant traffic that is tiny or blurred.
Flag cars, trucks, boats, or trailers parked in the driveway or on the lawn of the subject property. Do not flag vehicles on the street or in neighbors' driveways that do not overlap the home.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag garden hoses on lawns, beds, driveways, and patios, or coiled at the spigot. Do not flag irrigation heads, downspouts, or gutter extensions (permanent).

escalateTo.when: a reel cart sits in the foreground or a primary composition

visionHint: Flag hose reel carts, boxes, and wall-mounted reels loaded with hose. Do not flag an empty, small wall hanger.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag rakes, shovels, wheelbarrows, buckets, pots, bags of soil or mulch, and garden carts. Do not flag planted containers or permanent raised beds.

checklistText: Lawn mowers, trimmers, and leaf blowers
visionHint: Flag push or riding mowers, string trimmers, leaf blowers, and gas cans. Do not flag the HVAC condenser or a generator (permanent equipment).

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag ride-on toys, balls, sandboxes, plastic slides, and scattered outdoor toys. Do not flag permanent swing sets, playhouses, or in-ground play structures; those are property features.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag bicycles, scooters, skateboards, portable basketball hoops, nets, and sports gear. Do not flag in-ground basketball hoops or sport courts (permanent features).

checklistText: Pet accessories or visible pet waste

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag pet bowls, tie-outs, toys, portable kennels, and pet waste on lawns or walkways. Do not flag permanent dog runs or fencing.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag litter, bags, packaging, cups, and loose debris on lawns, driveways, porches, and curbs. Do not flag mulch, stone, or landscape edging.

checklistText: Cobwebs around doors, windows, railings, and outdoor structures

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the cobwebs from the eaves, light fixtures, door and window corners, and railings, keeping every surface underneath unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag visible cobwebs or spider webs in eaves, porch ceilings, light fixtures, door and window corners, and railings, especially when backlit. Do not flag thin wires, cables, or lens artifacts.

checklistText: Excessive leaves on porches, patios, decks, or walkways

escalateTo.when: leaves cover a significant part of a porch, deck, steps, or entry walkway in a primary photo

visionHint: Flag drifts or heavy scatter of leaves on porches, steps, decks, patios, and walkways. Do not flag leaves on lawns or natural beds in fall, or leaves still on trees.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag fallen branches, brush piles, storm debris, and dead plant waste on lawns, beds, and hardscape. Do not flag living shrubs, firewood stored in a rack, or natural wooded areas.

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag lumber, pallets, dumpsters, portable toilets, tarps, buckets, and debris piles. Do not flag landscaping stone or mulch installed in beds.
Flag ladders, scaffolding, sawhorses, generators on carts, pressure washers, and contractor equipment. Do not flag permanent attic or pool ladders.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Arrange the outdoor furniture neatly with chairs square to the table, cushions straight, and nothing piled on top, keeping the same furniture. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag patio chairs at random angles, furniture pushed into a corner, or tables covered with items. Do not flag a tidy seating group arranged in a conversational layout.

checklistText: Stacked patio chairs where the area should be staged

escalateTo.when: the patio or deck is a primary outdoor-living photo

visionHint: Flag stacked or folded patio chairs, tipped-up furniture, or furniture under covers where the space should look staged. Do not flag neatly stored furniture shown in a garage or shed photo.

checklistText: Wet, dirty, or poorly arranged outdoor cushions

escalateTo.when: visibly stained or soaked cushions in a primary photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Arrange the outdoor cushions neatly and evenly so they look clean and dry, keeping the same fabric color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag outdoor cushions that are water-darkened, stained, faded, tipped over, or missing from some seats. Do not flag furniture designed without cushions.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Make the patio umbrella stand upright, fully open, and centered over the table, keeping the same umbrella fabric. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag umbrellas half-open, tilted, wrapped crooked, or blocking the view of the home or patio. Do not flag a neatly closed umbrella standing upright.

checklistText: Grill accessories and covers creating distractions

escalateTo.when: a torn or faded cover or tool clutter is prominent in a primary photo

visionHint: Flag grill tools, propane tanks, charcoal bags, and messy or faded grill covers. Do not flag a built-in outdoor kitchen grill; never remove a cover in a way that invents the grill underneath.

checklistText: Pool toys or pool cleaning equipment

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

visionHint: Flag floats, noodles, toys, robotic pool cleaners, loose hoses, vacuum poles, and skimmer nets in or around the pool. Do not flag permanent pool features (ladders, handrails, lights, skimmer lids).

deescalateTo.when: item is small, partially visible, or in the background and not distracting

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the leaves and debris floating on the pool surface and resting on the pool floor, keeping the water color and pool finish unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag leaves, bugs, or debris floating on the pool surface or resting on the pool floor. Do not flag cloudy or green water as debris; that is a property condition for human review, not a cleanup edit.

checklistText: Partially displaced or messy pool covers

escalateTo.when: the pool is a primary amenity photo

visionHint: Flag pool covers that are half-pulled, sagging with water or debris, or bunched at one end. Never suggest generating the pool under a cover; that would misrepresent its condition.

escalateTo.when: obvious at a glance in a hero or primary photo of the room (poor furniture presentation)

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the hot tub cover so it sits flat and square on the tub, keeping the same cover color. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag hot tub covers half-open, propped at an angle, sliding off, or folded awkwardly. Do not flag a cover neatly folded onto a cover lifter or fully closed.

checklistText: Open garage doors in primary curb-appeal photographs

deescalateTo.when: not a primary curb-appeal photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open garage door using the same door style, color, and panel and window pattern as the other garage doors on the house. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag garage doors fully or partly open in front, twilight, or front aerial compositions. Do not flag a garage interior shot or a carport with no door.

checklistText: Open doors distracting from the exterior

escalateTo.when: an open front, storm, or shed door is visible in a primary curb-appeal photo

reeditPromptTemplate: Close the open door so it sits fully closed in its frame, matching the visible door style and hardware. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag front doors, storm doors, sliders, shed doors, or gates left open in exterior photos. Do not flag doors intentionally open in a lifestyle twilight shot noted in the order.

escalateTo.when: a face is recognizable and the order does not mark the photo as an approved lifestyle shot (privacy)

visionHint: Flag people in exterior or aerial photos: neighbors, pedestrians, workers, or occupants, including partial figures at frame edges. Skip photos the order marks as intentional lifestyle shots.

checklistText: Visible license plates that raise privacy concerns

deescalateTo.when: the plate is not legible at full resolution

visionHint: Flag license plates whose characters are legible at full resolution on any vehicle in frame, including neighbors' cars. Do not flag plates unreadable from distance, angle, or blur.

checklistText: Distracting objects obstructing exterior architectural details
visionHint: Flag movable objects (vehicles, bins, trailers, equipment, seasonal decorations) that hide the entry, windows, porch, garage doors, or roofline. Do not flag trees and shrubs; landscaping is a property feature, not a removable object.

checklistText: Missing or poorly represented outdoor amenities

escalateTo.when: the amenity is named in the order or client instructions and is absent from the gallery (missing requested feature)

visionHint: Across exterior photos, list the outdoor amenities shown (pool, spa, patio, deck, outdoor kitchen, fire pit, pergola, sport court) and flag amenities that appear only partially or in poor light. Coverage against the order is confirmed in P4.

Flag lawns or plants with neon, cyan-green, or flat painted-looking color, or patches that look pasted (often from a grass-greening transform). Do not flag naturally lush lawns or seasonal brown dormancy; brown grass is not an editing error.
cvHint: On vegetation pixels (HSV hue 60 to 160 degrees), flag when mean saturation exceeds 0.65 or hue standard deviation is below 4 degrees, which indicates a painted look (starting values, calibrate).

deescalateTo.when: slightly saturated and not distracting

visionHint: Confirm trees, shrubs, and lawns look unnaturally vivid compared with the rest of the scene. Do not flag flowering plants whose bright color is real.
cvHint: On vegetation pixels (HSV hue 60 to 160 degrees), flag when mean saturation exceeds 0.55 or more than 10% of those pixels exceed 0.85 saturation (starting values, calibrate).

checklistText: Exterior images that fail to show the complete home

escalateTo.when: no exterior photo in the gallery shows the whole front of the home (important architecture cropped off)

visionHint: Flag exterior photos where a side of the house, the roof, or the garage is cut off by the frame so the whole structure is not visible. Do not flag intentional detail or angle shots when a full front view exists.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
visionHint: Flag any human figure reflected in a mirror, including a partial arm, legs, or head behind a camera. Do not flag people in framed photos or artwork, or furniture reflections that resemble a figure.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Camera or tripod visible in mirrors
visionHint: Flag a camera, tripod, tripod legs, or light stand visible in mirrors, mirrored closet doors, or mirror-like backsplashes. Check for the three-leg tripod pattern near the frame center; do not flag floor lamps or furniture legs.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Photographer visible in glass doors or windows
visionHint: Flag the photographer, camera, or tripod reflected in windows, glass doors, oven doors, glazed artwork, or TV screens (common at dusk or against dark exteriors). Do not flag people who are actually outside the window.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the photographer's shadow from the ground, restoring the lawn, driveway, or floor underneath to match its surroundings. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag a human-shaped shadow at the bottom edge of the frame (lawn, driveway, floor) cast toward the subject, typical of sunny exteriors shot with the sun behind the camera. Do not flag tree, fence, or building shadows.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects

escalateTo.when: the shadow is large or sits in the foreground of a hero photo

visionHint: Flag tripod-leg or light-stand shadows radiating from the bottom center of the frame, or drone shadows on roofs and lawns. Do not flag furniture-leg shadows.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Flash reflections in mirrors or windows

deescalateTo.when: small and not distracting

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the bright flash reflection from the mirror or window, restoring the natural reflection or view behind it. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag bright starbursts or white hotspots in mirrors, windows, framed glass, or glossy art caused by on-camera or bounced flash. Do not flag light fixtures or the sun seen through a window.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects

escalateTo.when: the reflection shows the photographer, a bright window hotspot, or clutter

reeditPromptTemplate: Reduce the distracting reflections on the appliance fronts so the finish looks evenly brushed, keeping the appliance shape, handles, and controls unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag stainless or glossy appliance fronts showing hot white streaks, window reflections, or reflected clutter. Do not flag the normal soft sheen of stainless steel.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Distracting reflections on glossy cabinets or countertops

escalateTo.when: hot specular streaks hide the material or read as damage

reeditPromptTemplate: Reduce the distracting reflections on the glossy cabinet or countertop so the material and color read clearly, keeping its pattern and edges unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag glossy cabinets, quartz, or polished stone showing hot streaks of window or fixture light that hide the material. Do not flag the normal soft sheen of polished surfaces.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Lens flare or bright glare spots

deescalateTo.when: faint and not distracting

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the lens flare and glare spots, restoring the underlying surfaces naturally. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag flare rings, polygon ghosts, starbursts, or veiling haze from the sun or bright fixtures. Do not flag a natural sun star in a deliberate sunset or twilight composition unless it hides the home.
cvHint: Find bright compact blobs (luma above 245, area 0.05% to 2% of the frame) outside window and fixture bboxes, plus low-contrast veiling regions near the sun; pass as candidates to vision (starting values, calibrate).

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the colored glare artifacts, restoring the underlying surfaces naturally. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag green, purple, or rainbow blobs or streaks (lens ghosting or chromatic flare), often mirrored across the frame center from a bright light. Do not flag colored decor or stained glass.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects

deescalateTo.when: small and not distracting

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the white glare marks, restoring the underlying surface texture and color. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag washed-out white patches or streaks on floors, walls, counters, or windows from reflected sunlight or flash. Do not flag surfaces that are actually white materials.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects

escalateTo.when: the same spot recurs in 3 or more photos (repeated sensor dust throughout the gallery)

visionHint: Confirm CV candidates: a soft-edged, semi-transparent, roughly circular dark spot, most visible on flat bright surfaces (sky, ceilings, walls). Reject real objects: nail holes, outlet screws, switches, vents, recessed lights, smoke detectors, birds, wood knots, and texture.
cvHint: Downscale to 2048 px long edge, convert to luma, subtract a Gaussian blur (sigma about 25 px) to get local contrast, then find dark blobs 4 to 40 px across, at least 4 luma levels (0 to 255) darker than the local background, circularity above 0.6, in low-texture regions (local Laplacian variance below the 40th percentile). Record the normalized centroid (x / width, y / height) for cross-image recurrence. Starting values, calibrate.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects

deescalateTo.when: a single faint spot that is not visible at full-screen viewing

visionHint: Confirm CV candidates: larger, very soft blotches or small bright specks that sit at the same spot in photos taken with the same lens. Reject bokeh from real lights, water droplets on windows, and texture.
cvHint: Same pipeline as sensor dust but with blob diameter 20 to 120 px at 2048 px and contrast of at least 3 luma levels; also detect bright specks (lighter than background by 6 or more levels) against dark areas. Starting values, calibrate.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Repeated spots appearing in the same location across multiple images

deescalateTo.when: the spot recurs in only 2 photos, or only over busy textured areas where it is hard to see

visionHint: Confirm each clustered instance is a dust spot and not a real object that happens to sit at the same position in similar compositions (for example recessed lights in repeated angles).
cvHint: Cluster dust candidates from all photos by normalized centroid with a radius of 0.01 of the long edge; a cluster is a repeated spot when it holds candidates from 3 or more photos from the same camera body (EXIF serial when present). Compare only photos with the same orientation and aspect ratio, and prefer original frames when available because perspective correction shifts coordinates. Starting values, calibrate.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Dark spots on walls, ceilings, doors, cabinets, or other flat surfaces

deescalateTo.when: a single faint spot that is not visible at full-screen viewing

visionHint: Confirm whether each dark spot is dust (soft edge, semi-transparent, round) or a physical mark. If it looks like a physical mark (scuff, stain, water damage, hole, crack), report it as a property condition for human review, not as dust, and do not propose removal.
cvHint: Run the sensor-dust blob detector restricted to flat regions (vision bboxes for walls, ceilings, doors, cabinets, or Laplacian variance below the 30th percentile). Starting values, calibrate.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Dust spots overlooked because they are small

escalateTo.when: visible at normal full-screen viewing, or the same spot recurs across photos

visionHint: Confirm tiny candidates by zooming into each crop: accept only soft, round, semi-transparent specks on flat areas. Reject texture grain, noise, and small real objects.
cvHint: Run the dust detector at full resolution with blob diameter 2 to 8 px and contrast of at least 3 luma levels, only in flat regions (Laplacian variance below the 20th percentile). Starting values, calibrate.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
visionHint: Flag hazy, smeared, or low-contrast patches, soft glowing streaks around lights, or a fingerprint-like smear, often repeating across photos. Do not flag intentional soft focus, fog, or steam.
cvHint: On a 128 px grid compute Laplacian variance and saturation; flag a contiguous region whose variance is below 30% of the image median with similar luminance to its neighbors and lowered saturation (haze). Starting values, calibrate.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects

escalateTo.when: a large distracting object (dumpster, trash, construction) is centered in a window view

visionHint: Flag distracting objects visible through windows or glass doors: bins, dumpsters, construction, clutter on a deck. Do not flag neighboring houses, trees, or normal views.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Distracting reflections mistaken for physical objects

escalateTo.when: the reflection could mislead a viewer about what is in the room

reeditPromptTemplate: Reduce the confusing reflection on the surface so it no longer reads as an object, keeping the surface material and color unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag reflections in windows, glossy floors, or appliances that read as a physical object (a floating lamp, a ghost doorway, a doubled window). Do not flag reflections that are clearly recognizable as reflections.

deescalateTo.when: the tilt is under about 1 degree and only visible on close inspection

visionHint: Flag wall corners, door frames, cabinets, or window edges that lean instead of running vertical (keystoning or camera tilt). Do not flag lines that are truly not vertical (sloped ceilings, stair stringers) or deliberate creative angles.
cvHint: Sobel edge orientation on a 1024 px luma image: collect strong edges within 15 degrees of vertical, compute the length-weighted median deviation from vertical, and flag above 1.0 degree. Skip when fewer than 8 qualifying edges. Starting values, calibrate.

deescalateTo.when: the lean is under about 1 degree

visionHint: Flag door frames and door slabs that lean in or out of vertical. Do not flag doors that are physically open at an angle.
cvHint: Sobel edge orientation on a 1024 px luma image: collect strong edges within 15 degrees of vertical, compute the length-weighted median deviation from vertical, and flag above 1.0 degree. Skip when fewer than 8 qualifying edges. Starting values, calibrate.

visionHint: Flag straight walls, ceiling lines, or floor edges that bow outward or inward (barrel or pincushion distortion), especially near the frame edges. Do not flag genuinely curved architecture such as arches or rounded walls.
Flag windows that look trapezoidal, stretched, or warped near the frame edges, or whose grids bend. Do not flag windows that are truly non-rectangular (transoms, bays seen at an angle).
Flag rooflines, beams, countertops, or trim that should be straight but curve in the image. Do not flag designed curves.

Flag images with strong barrel distortion where the center bulges and edges curve, or an ultra-wide look that warps the room. Do not flag mild edge stretch from a rectilinear wide lens that keeps lines straight.

escalateTo.when: the stretched object is large or in a hero photo

visionHint: Flag chairs, tables, lamps, or beds near the frame edges that look elongated or egg-shaped from wide-angle projection. Do not flag furniture that is genuinely oversized.

Flag rooms that look unnaturally deep or tunnel-like from an ultra-wide lens or aggressive vertical correction, with furniture stretched away from the camera. Do not flag long rooms that are genuinely long (galley kitchens, hallways).

checklistText: Rooms appearing unusually narrow due to editing
visionHint: Compare to the original and flag when the edit squeezes the room horizontally (aspect change, heavy perspective warp, or tight crop) so it reads narrower than the original capture.

escalateTo.when: the room looks skewed or the back wall is visibly not level

visionHint: Flag straight-on (one-point) compositions where horizontal lines on the back wall slope, making the room look skewed. Do not flag normal two-point convergence in corner compositions.
cvHint: For near-horizontal edges (within 10 degrees) in the central third of the frame, compute the median slope; flag straight-on compositions where it exceeds 1.5 degrees. Starting value, calibrate.
